translation: The three yang channels that return from Quepen and go up to the head all attach to the throat; rubbing the tip of the lower jaw, the accumulation then disperses upward. The hand yangming goes from the tip of the lower jaw, around the lips and nose to the root of the nose, meets the foot yangming, goes to the upper lip, lower jaw, and jaw, up in front of the ear, to the forehead and skull; the hand taiyang goes from the upper tip of the jaw, turning back outside the jaw, from Daying to the cheekbone, to the inner canthus, meeting the foot taiyang, up the forehead and crossing the crown; the hand shaoyang goes from Danzhong, from the throat out to the lower outer corner of the jaw, from the neck out above the ear to the outer canthus, meeting the foot shaoyang, up the head corner, and down behind the ear. But the three yang descending the neck all go from the jaw down to Daying and Renying.
